label: 生成 SceneSpec
description: 静态路终端编译器：把纯静态 Geometry（part/mesh/material，无 joint/skin）编译成 SceneSpec JSON（静态 IR，类比 URDF/RigSpec）——一组已置位、已上色的网格引用。单物体（真形状 part）由上游 g_bake_object 合并成单个多材质 GLB（object_filename 端口）；场景组装（mesh(filename=<sha>.obj) 引用 part）逐 part 列出 mesh + origin/rpy + 颜色。前端 live-sync 拉取后加载并组合，导出合并成单个 .glb。
description-en: Static terminal compiler: pure-static Geometry (part/mesh/material, no joint/skin) → SceneSpec JSON (static IR, URDF/RigSpec analogue) — a list of placed, colored mesh refs. A single object (real-shape parts) is merged into one multi-material GLB by upstream g_bake_object (object_filename port); a scene (mesh(filename=<sha>.obj) ref parts) lists each mesh + origin/rpy + color. The frontend live-sync loads and composes them; export merges to one .glb.

inputs.name: geometry
inputs.label: 几何
inputs.description: 纯静态几何（part + mesh/真形状 + material）

inputs.name: object_filename
inputs.label: 物体网格文件名
inputs.description: 单物体合并 GLB <sha>.glb（通常接 g_bake_object.filename）
inputs.description-en: Merged single-object GLB <sha>.glb (usually wired from g_bake_object.filename).

outputs.name: sceneSpec
outputs.label: SceneSpec
outputs.description: 静态 IR 对象（已置位、已上色的网格引用列表）
outputs.description-en: Static IR object (list of placed, colored mesh refs).

outputs.name: scene_json
outputs.label: SceneSpec JSON
outputs.description: SceneSpec 的 JSON 字符串
